newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Port of Singapore Sept container throughput fell.
newsitem.headline: Port of Singapore Sept container throughput fell.

text.p: Container throughput at the Port of Singapore Authority fell in September to 1.086 million TEU (twenty-foot equivalent units) from 1.129 million TEU in August, PSA said in its latest monthly report.
But it said total cargo tonnage moved through Singapore in September rose to 26.673 million tonnes from August's 26.035 million tonnes.
In September, 9,837 vessels called at the port, compared with 9,888 in August.
Bunker fuel sales for 380 centistoke fuel oil was 790,000 tonnes in September, higher from 745,400 tonnes in August.
The 180 centistoke fuel sales 395,000 tonnes against August's 404,600 tonnes.
